name: Kilia Rindoval
original_name: キリア・リンドヴァール
source:
General of the Balunrain army. A mixed-race child born in the palace after the looting of Balunrain. She was raised by Akbar from an early age, but has no blood connection to him.
Kilia also acts as a personal guard of Lilfinia.
